Request changes on PR #132 (build(0003)). Three findings of the fresh-context review of the diff are fixed in this round, with a test each; the rest is the owner's choice.

**Fix in this round**
1. `plugin/gate/checks.py`, `_supersedes_problem`: the `supersedes` value is joined to `lessons/` unchecked, so `supersedes: ../secret.txt` reads a file outside `lessons/` and the gate quotes that file's first unparsable line into the "What I need from you" text (`yamlish`'s error messages carry the offending line); an absolute path passes when it points at a retired lesson anywhere, and a lesson that supersedes itself passes. Decided: a `supersedes` value must be a bare file name matching `[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-*.md` (`Path(value).name == value`), not the lesson's own name; anything else is one problem line "supersedes must name a lesson file in lessons/"; the "is unreadable" line names the file only, never the parser's message. One test per case in `tests/test_gate.py`.
2. `plugin/lessons/index.py`: the spec says a bad file never stops the build, but three parsable frontmatters crash `build` and `check` with a traceback — `stale_after: 2027` (an int: `TypeError` in `_date_only`), `detected.at: "2026-13-01…"` (`IndexError` in `_month_label`), and a lesson file that is not UTF-8 (`UnicodeDecodeError`, which `_read_text` does not catch: it catches `OSError` only). Through the gate this becomes a "check crashed" park that hides the real problem. Decided: each goes to `## Unsorted` with a note naming the field and the reason (`_read_text` catches `UnicodeDecodeError` too; `_date_only` and `_month_label` accept a string of the right shape only). One `tests/test_lessons.py` case per input.
3. `plugin/commands/sdlc-maintain.md` step 1: it opens the lessons whose heading or `Tags:` clause names the metric or the rule, plus `## Retired`, and never `## Unsorted`; the spec and the README say a frontmatter-less lesson is still read by the diagnosis. Add "plus every lesson under `## Unsorted`" and assert it in `tests/test_commands_and_skills.py`.

**Can wait for the tag (0.3.7); include or drop**
4. `tests/test_gate.py`: five of the eight fail-case tests carry two problems at once (the index is not built, so `index.py check` fails too), and no test asserts the whole rendered block; make each case one problem and assert the full `what_i_need()` text once.
5. `plugin/lessons/index.py` line 210: the `Tags:` clause prints the raw `tags` list; the spec's clause is the normalised class, the metric, then the `runbook` field's name when present. Add a test asserting one exact index line.
6. `plugin/commands/sdlc-deploy.md` step 0b and the README: say that `description` carries no trailing period (the line adds it; "d." renders "d.."), that a scan-filed incident's class tag is `evidence/scan-finding.json: class`, and where its `detected.at` comes from.
7. `plugin/lessons/index.py`: `check` calls `build` logic that runs `lessons_dir.mkdir(...)`, so a read-only `check` creates `lessons/` (reproduced on an empty root); move the `mkdir` to the `build` command, and reject a `--today` that is not an ISO date.
8. `plugin/gate/artifacts.py` line 89 and `plugin/gate/checks.py` line 1628: two comments read "eval (" and match the security-baseline scanner's pattern (advisory only; the same shape the preflight parked on). Reword.
9. `docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md` line 144: "a heading per tag" is "a heading per class (the first tag)".
